say:0:1710557001:1.source_cn: 你伸手触碰餐盘边缘，指尖传来异样的触感——某种极细的纤...

say:1:1710557002:0.text: After dripping sauce onto it, their true form appears: nearly invisible threads, holding the dish in perfect suspension.
say:1:1710557002:0.source_cn: 你将汁液洒在上面之后，终于看清了它们的真面目——又是肉...

say:2:1710557003:1.female: As you focus, the strands tighten and vanish with a silent snap, as if they were never there.

say:9:1710557006:1.text: The plates are teleported into position, then stabilized by threads to create the illusion of descent.
say:9:1710557006:1.source_cn: 餐盘先是通过传送魔法送至固定餐桌，再借由丝线的粘附与稳...

say:10:1710557007:1.text: The magic itself isn't rare, but sustaining this level of control across an entire restaurant proves Voracia is a mage of exceptional caliber.
say:10:1710557007:1.source_cn: 施展这样的魔法本身并不算太难，但能在如此大型的餐厅中维...

say:11:1710557008:0.text: Magister Merlin... the Evergreen Exhibition, where my father vanished...
say:11:1710557008:0.source_cn: 梅林阁下……您还记得父亲此前失踪的冬青展览馆吗？
